nodes.label: M52 (import purchase entity)
nodes.rationale: Separate financial/ledger entity from Royal Hardware for import purchases and M52-channel sales, while sharing master data (products, categories, brands, units, warehouses, customers, suppliers).

nodes.label: Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API decision
nodes.rationale: Chosen over unofficial WhatsApp libraries specifically to avoid the risk of a business number being banned - business-verified, template-based, ToS-compliant.
nodes.norm_label: official meta whatsapp cloud api decision

nodes.label: Transaction-based inventory rule
nodes.rationale: Stock quantity is never edited directly; it is always the sum of Stock Movements, so every quantity can be traced back to the movements that produced it.

nodes.label: tests/unit/modules/inventory/stock/stock-ledger.test.ts
nodes.rationale: Covers FR-PROD-006 Weighted Average Cost including the zero-quantity divide-by-zero edge case.

nodes.label: src/modules/inventory/stock/services/stock-ledger.service.ts
nodes.rationale: postStockMovement was refactored to extract computeBalanceAfterMovement as a pure function specifically so the average-cost math is testable without a database.

nodes.label: CI pipeline (.github/workflows/ci.yml)
nodes.rationale: Runs tsc --noEmit, lint, unit tests, and a production build against a placeholder DATABASE_URL - catches type/build regressions but not schema-drift or runtime/query errors.

nodes.label: FR-PROD-002
nodes.rationale: A product cannot be deleted (only deactivated) once it has any stock movement or transaction reference, enforced at the service layer, not just a DB constraint.

nodes.label: FR-PROD-003
nodes.rationale: Products are shared master data: both Royal Hardware and M52 reference the same Product record.

nodes.label: FR-PROD-006 (Weighted Average Cost)
nodes.rationale: Average Cost recalculated on every Purchase via Weighted Average Cost, computed per warehouse since a product's average cost can legitimately differ by warehouse; flagged as an assumption pending confirmation.

nodes.label: FR-PROD-007
nodes.rationale: Architecture must allow future price tiers (Retail vs Wholesale) without schema redesign, even though only one tier is required now.

nodes.label: FR-PROD-008
nodes.rationale: Minimum/Maximum Stock thresholds are per warehouse per product, not global.

nodes.label: FR-UNIT-002 (transitive unit conversion)
nodes.rationale: Conversions are transitive within a product's defined unit chain; the system resolves any-to-any conversion by multiplying factors along the path rather than requiring every pair defined explicitly.

nodes.label: FR-UNIT-003
nodes.rationale: Conversion factors are defined per product, not globally per unit pair.

nodes.label: FR-STK-001
nodes.rationale: There is no direct 'edit stock quantity' action anywhere - every stock change comes from a typed movement (Purchase, Sale, Transfer, Adjustment, Return, Damage, Correction).

nodes.label: FR-XFER-001
nodes.rationale: A Stock Transfer always creates two linked movements (outbound from A, inbound to B) sharing one Transfer reference number.

nodes.label: FR-XFER-002
nodes.rationale: Transfer workflow states Initiated -> In Transit -> Received (or Rejected); stock leaves source on-hand immediately but only appears in destination on-hand once Received.

nodes.label: FR-XFER-003
nodes.rationale: Partial receipt creates a variance that must be resolved via a Stock Adjustment with reason 'Transfer Variance'.

nodes.label: FR-SALE-001
nodes.rationale: One Sales table for all channels, with Sales Channel stored as a lookup so a channel can be added via Settings without a migration.

nodes.label: FR-SALE-002
nodes.rationale: Each Sales Channel maps to exactly one Company for ledger/GST purposes, configurable in Settings rather than hardcoded.

nodes.label: FR-SALE-004
nodes.rationale: A Sale cannot post exceeding available stock unless an explicit Admin-only 'Allow Negative Stock' override is used and logged.

nodes.label: FR-QUO-002
nodes.rationale: Converting a Quotation to an Invoice supports partial conversion; the Quotation remains open for the unconverted remainder.

nodes.label: FR-QUO-003
nodes.rationale: A Quotation does not affect stock or ledgers until converted - it is a non-transactional document.

nodes.label: FR-USER-002
nodes.rationale: Roles are data-driven records; Permissions are granular per-module actions assigned to Roles, not hardcoded per user.

nodes.label: FR-USER-003
nodes.rationale: Default seeded Roles: Admin (all permissions) and Salesman (restricted, explicitly denied Cost Price/Average Cost/Profit/Purchases/Expenses/Supplier Ledger/Users/Roles/Settings).

nodes.label: FR-USER-010
nodes.rationale: Cost/margin visibility is enforced at the API layer, not just hidden in UI - a Salesman-scoped request must never receive cost fields in the response payload.

nodes.label: FR-AUDIT-001
nodes.rationale: Every Create/Update/Delete writes an Audit Log entry with user, table/record, old/new value JSON, timestamp, IP, user agent, and reason (required for Deletes/Adjustments).

nodes.label: FR-WA-001
nodes.rationale: Integrates with the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API using pre-approved templates for Invoice, Quotation, Ledger Statement, Outstanding Reminder, Payment Confirmation, Order Confirmation.

nodes.label: FR-BAK-001
nodes.rationale: Manual and Automatic Daily Backup produce a CSV export set and ZIP archive, optionally uploaded to Google Drive via OAuth.

nodes.label: Repository Pattern (strictly enforced)
nodes.rationale: Only repositories/ imports @/lib/db; services never construct a Drizzle query directly - keeps business rules like FR-PROD-002 out of query code where they'd be easy to miss, and makes swapping the data layer later actually possible.

nodes.label: Five-folder module pattern
nodes.rationale: Every module (components/actions/services/repositories/schemas/types/hooks) has the same shape so any feature is navigated the same way as the module count grows.

nodes.label: Audit logging as a service-layer concern
nodes.rationale: A Postgres trigger can't see the requester's IP/user-agent, so every services/*.ts mutation calls a shared lib/audit/log.ts helper instead.
nodes.norm_label: audit logging as a service-layer concern

nodes.label: CompanyProvider/WarehouseProvider context
nodes.rationale: Client-side context is for UX only; Server Actions re-validate against user_company_access/user_warehouse_access server-side on every call, never trusting the client value as the access-control decision.

nodes.label: Stock Transfer screen
nodes.rationale: Three-state stepper (Initiated -> In Transit -> Received) with a variance column, visualizing FR-XFER-002/003.

nodes.label: Quotation -> Invoice screen
nodes.rationale: Partial conversion via per-line qty + checkbox, plus a conversion history table, visualizing FR-QUO-002.

nodes.label: Customer Ledger screen
nodes.rationale: Per-company balance switch (Royal Hardware / M52) on the same customer.

nodes.label: Settings & Roles screen
nodes.rationale: Permission matrix as the actual data model; Sales Channel -> Company mapping table.

nodes.label: ActionResult discriminated union pattern
nodes.rationale: A single result shape means every module's TanStack Query hook unwraps results identically and every form surfaces fieldErrors the same way, avoiding per-module bespoke error handling.

nodes.label: requirePermission() guard
nodes.rationale: Every Server Action follows the same five steps, with requirePermission throwing caught centrally and converted to PERMISSION_DENIED so individual actions never write their own auth-check logic.

nodes.label: Atomic idempotent posting pattern
nodes.rationale: Every post action performs its status transition as a single conditional UPDATE...WHERE status='draft' inside the same transaction as stock/ledger writes; zero rows back means CONFLICT, making a double-click or client retry safe without a separate idempotency-key table.

nodes.label: Route Handlers as the exception, not the default
nodes.rationale: app/api/ exists only for callers that are not the ERP's own UI - the WhatsApp webhook, the backup cron, and binary PDF/CSV downloads.
nodes.norm_label: route handlers as the exception, not the default
